# --- wire / record payload keys (strings in the emitted dict, no Python name) --
# `ui_nav_state` reports each overlay child with `owned_by_section` and
# `keyboard_ring` as *dict keys* (src/core/control/nav_state.py); ast cannot
# index a string key, so the checker cannot resolve them.
owned_by_section
keyboard_ring
# Evidence-journal record `kind` label (`_KIND_VERDICTS` member in
# src/core/evidence/journal.py); a string value, not a symbol.
target_bug

# --- Qt key names written in prose -------------------------------------------
# `Enter`/`Space`/`Return` name key sequences (Qt.Key.Key_Space, key labels),
# not app symbols; only `Enter` happens to collide with an indexed name.
Return
Space

# --- widget objectName / Find Action ids -------------------------------------
# `setObjectName("quicklook_close")` (quick_look/overlay_build/build.py) — a
# runtime string id, not a Python name.
quicklook_close

# --- result-payload key names (documented in prose, not Python symbols) ------
# ui_elements/docs: the pre-limit match count key returned in the payload.
matched_total

# --- contract-test prose (tests/.../test_gallery_action_context.py) -----------
# Deleted helper named in a docstring that asserts its absence — the test scans
# AST for this name on purpose.
_first_item_path
# Refusal reason string literal used by the analyse path (a value, not a symbol).
not_configured

# 2026-10-28 — the public CI ran this gate for the first time (Actions were
# billing-blocked on the private mirror), and it had been failing on tokens
# that are NOT stale repo symbols:
#   * product/domain prose (`BlinkTable`, `canvas_px`, `line_crispness`, …);
#   * external libraries and OS tools the tree names in prose
#     (`skimage`, `scipy`, `Pillow`, `GtkFileChooserDialog`, `secret-tool`);
#   * test fixtures / session names (`secret_store_keyring`, …);
#   * identifiers that DO exist but sit behind a re-export or a dynamic
#     attribute (`reset_metrics_caches`, `quicklook_right_host`, …) — the
#     checker resolves DEFINITIONS, not runtime attributes.
# Emitted by `check_comment_citations.py --emit-allowlist`; the ratchet only
# shrinks, so a later real staleness still fails.
BlinkTable
CON
CONx
GtkFileChooserDialog
HelpDocumentView
Pillow
TextView
